name: example
description: template for an app that requires sign-in — copy, do not edit in place
//startUrl: optional: where the take begins, relative to app (default '/')
//pageUrlMatch: extra hosts that still count as 'the app' (SSO, payments)

auth.//mode: 'form' fills a username/password form. 'none' disables sign-in.
auth.//start: 'signed-out' (default) signs out off camera so the take opens on the login page — use with a `login` step. 'signed-in' signs in off camera so the take opens inside the app.
auth.//credentials: put real values in example.local.json (gitignored), or leave these env: references and set the variables in productvideos/.env
auth.//selectors: same grammar as a scenario: 'btn:Exact Text' or a puppeteer selector

//secrets: anything else a flow types on camera; read with d.secret('name') or `type secret name into ...`
